public_rationale: The claim is that GPT-5 had not been released by 9 January 2025. On 21 December 2024, TechCrunch, summarizing the WSJ, reported that GPT-5 was still in development and behind schedule. It added that OpenAI had said it would not release Orion in 2024. OpenAI's own launch page introduces GPT-5 on 7 August 2025. So GPT-5 had not come out when Marcus wrote. The phrase about 'daily shouts of exponential progress' is rhetoric and is not scored.
limitations: The in-period evidence is a news summary of a paywalled WSJ report.
The rhetorical framing about 'exponential progress' claims was not tested.
